name: termhub
description: Terminais das suas máquinas no navegador, organizados em Máquinas > Projetos > Tabs

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @termhub/server" "npm run dev -w @termhub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @termhub/web && npm run build -w @termhub/server
scripts.test: npm test -w @termhub/agent-protocol && npm test -w @termhub/machine-ops && npm test -w @termhub/claude-cli && npm test -w @termhub/mobile-api && npm test -w @termhub/server && npm test -w @termhub/web && npm test -w @termhub/mobile && npm test -w @termhub/agent
